scope.required_cpu: AMD EPYC 9224, as required by the competition CPU profile
scope.eligible_product: CPU-only, no GPU attached or mandatory

findings.result: Exact 24-core EPYC 9224 dedicated servers are publicly listed, but the official listing is monthly-priced (US location page shows a 24-month-term price) and does not offer hourly rental. Historical independent VPS trials also identified EPYC 9224 hosts but explicitly say hourly billing is unavailable; these are not current inventory checks.
findings.fit: exact_cpu; fails hourly and USD 3 total budget

sources.supports: AMD Genoa 24 Cores uses AMD EPYC 9224; monthly price and Get Started listing.
EPYC 9224 dedicated host was listed at EUR 239/month; announcement updated June 2026.
October 2024 VPS trial observed an EPYC 9224; plan table reports no hourly billing.

findings.availability_limit: No purchase/configuration flow was entered; listing does not prove an immediately deployable slot.

findings.result: Official site advertises pay-as-you-go CPU Cloud with Xeon/EPYC hardware from USD 0.012/hour. Public CPU deployment preview shows a default 4-core/16-GB/100-GB example at USD 0.0490/hour, billed per second with no minimum, but requires authentication to deploy and does not identify or guarantee the host CPU SKU.
findings.fit: CPU-only hourly billing is a possible lead; exact EPYC 9224 inventory/guarantee not established

sources.supports: CPU Cloud, latest Xeon and EPYC CPUs, from USD 0.012/hour; pay-as-you-go billing.
Example CPU-only config at USD 0.0490/hour, billed per second/no minimum; authentication required to deploy. No processor model is shown.

findings.availability_limit: No login, account, API, or deployment action was used; public material is insufficient to qualify an exact-CPU purchase.

findings.result: Exact dual EPYC 9224 appears only in listings bundling RTX PRO 6000 or H200 GPUs; prices are monthly.
findings.fit: excluded mandatory GPU bundle; fails CPU-only and budget requirements

sources.supports: RTX PRO 6000 + 2x EPYC 9224 at USD 1,299/month and H200 NVL + 2x EPYC 9224 at USD 2,499/month; listings are GPU servers.

findings.result: EPYC 9224 appears as the CPU in an AI Mid product bundled with an L40S GPU at USD 549/month.
findings.fit: excluded mandatory GPU bundle; fails CPU-only and budget requirements

sources.supports: Spire AI Mid lists 32 vCPU EPYC 9224 with 1x NVIDIA L40S at USD 549/month.

findings.result: Previously inspected sanitized API receipts found the exact EPYC 9224 offer only with an H200 GPU bundle; zero-GPU results were disk volumes rather than CPU compute.
findings.fit: no eligible CPU-only offer in inspected inventory

sources.supports: Exact-CPU Vast search and offer classification.
CPU-only clarification and zero-GPU result classification.

conclusion: This bounded public search found no qualified CPU-only exact EPYC 9224 hourly/per-second option within USD 3. TensorDock remains unverified because its public CPU cloud pages do not pin the CPU SKU; Contabo has exact-SKU monthly listings, and other exact-SKU leads bundle GPUs. This does not establish global absence. No provider mutation or spend occurred.
